name: Betelgeza
source:
Join a Rachite on their final pilgrimage, only to learn that everything they've devoted their life to may not be what it appears.

[From [url=https://paleriddara.itch.io/betelgeza]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
陪一位拉奇特人踏上此生最後一次朝聖之旅。途中，這位朝聖者才發現，自己為之奉獻一生的一切，或許與表面所見大不相同。

［取自[url=https://paleriddara.itch.io/betelgeza]itch.io[/url]］
